label: A

claims.claim: a floating Liquid Glass tab bar (Today, Library, Stats) with Search as a separate circular glass button on the right
claims.evidence: render/today.png, book.png, empty.png: capsule tab bar with Today/Library/Stats and a separate round Search button at trailing edge

claims.claim: The tab bar sits at y 774–836, above the 34 pt home-indicator zone ... The top toolbar row starts at y 62
claims.evidence: render/today.png @2x: tab bar spans about 1548–1672 px = 774–836 pt, clear of the home indicator; the + and back/more glass buttons start just below the status bar

claims.claim: Accent colour is brick red #A8401F (6.1:1 on white ...). Secondary text is #5E5E63 (≥5.3:1 on both backgrounds) ... keeps tab labels above AA contrast
claims.evidence: facts.json: 0 contrast failures on all three screens (46 + 34 + 15 text nodes); lowest 5.09 on today/empty. Lowest on book is 4.80 (measured from pixels over the green-tinted header), still AA but below the quoted 5.3 figure

claims.claim: Text is at least 13 pt except the 10 pt tab labels
claims.evidence: render/today.png: cover lettering 'WALDEN' and 'THE PILLOW BOOK' is 5.5 px, 'GEORGE ELIOT' 7 px; render/book.png cover author 9 px (today.html/book.html inline styles). Decorative cover placeholders, not UI text; facts report no contrast failure for them

claims.claim: the goal ring, '8 min to go', the streak (4 days, best 23) and this week's minutes share one card ... Today's 12 min is labelled 'Today'. The dashed line marks the 20-min goal
claims.evidence: render/today.png: one card with ring '12 of 20', '8 min to go', '4-day streak · Best 23', week bars with dashed goal line and 'Goal 20 min' legend, last bar labelled '12 Today' in accent

claims.claim: 'Continue Reading' puts Start Session and Log Pages on the last-read book (Middlemarch). Walden and The Pillow Book appear as compact cards with progress and last-session day
claims.evidence: render/today.png: Middlemarch card holds filled Start Session and tinted Log Pages; half-width cards 'Walden 61% · Thu' and 'The Pillow Book 18% · 14 Sep'

claims.claim: The recent highlight continues below the fold
claims.evidence: render/today.png shows no highlight on the first screen (consistent); today.html contains the p. 194 highlight, but it is off-frame in the 874 pt render

claims.claim: Sessions list the four given entries, and 'See All' leads to all 23

claims.claim: the header has a soft green tint taken from the cover colour
